"This service is required to enable a variety of MacroDroid features as listed below:
App Launched/Closed trigger Recent Apps Trigger Android Shortcut action Press Back action Screen Off Action Take ScreenShot action Fingerprint Gesture trigger Volume Button Pressed trigger

The other modes simulate a media button press, control the default media player or simulate an audio button press."

"This option sends commands directly to the app's media session and requires notification access to be granted to MacroDroid.
The app must be running with an active media session. If the app may not be running, precede this action with a launch application action and a short wait."

"Creates a chart from array or dictionary variable data. The data should be structured such that the index/key represents the x-axis value and the (integer or decimal) value represents the y-axis values.

The chart can be displayed immediately or saved as an image file. When being displayed directly it can be cleared by calling the Clear MacroDroid Dialog action."

"Jumps execution to the action with the specified label. Labels can be added to any action via the \"Add label/comment\" menu option.
Select a target label from the dropdown. Only labels at the same nesting level and scope are available.

When denied the actions in the If clause will skipped."

"This action uses on device AI/Machine Learning technology to generate a description of an image.
The source image can be taken directly with the device camera or via an existing image file.
Note that only English language output is available at this time. You can use the Translate Text action if you need a different language.
This action is only available on powerful modern devices that support the Android Gemini Nano on device AI features."
This action allows you to configure the immersive mode of your device.

"This action can be used to inject a key event into the system (simulates a key press on an attached keyboard).
Key events are delivered via the accessibility service's input method, so most keys only work while a text input field is focused (e.g. Tab or letter keys pressed with no text field focused will do nothing).
If no text input field is focused the following keys are instead delivered as system navigation actions: D-pad up/down/left/right/center, back, home, app switch (recents) and headset hook. Page up and page down will scroll the content currently on screen. In these cases any modifier keys are ignored and the key down only / key up only options are not supported.
This action requires Android 13+."
This action allows you to set the global colour inversion setting on the device.

"This action is a specialized type of loop that can be used to iterate over all elements within a dictionary/array.
The current dictionary key/array index can be obtained within the loop using the following magic text strings:
[iterator_dictionary_key] [iterator_array_index]
The current dictionary/array value can be obtained with the following magic text:
[iterator_value]"

"This action can be used to run Java code including access to standard Android APIs.

"Measures the sound level from the selected audio input for the configured period and stores the maximum, average and/or minimum level into number variables.
Levels are measured in dB relative to the maximum input level, so 0 dB is the loudest value the input can register and silence is around -90 dB. Louder sounds therefore give values closer to 0.
This is a blocking action, the next action will not run until the capture period has elapsed and the variables have been set.
Please note: if another app is actively using the audio input the capture may fail or record silence. On Android 12+ the capture will record silence if the microphone has been disabled via the system privacy toggle."
